test_1_sbg_vs_random.description: SBG V5 AUROC vs random baseline
test_1_sbg_vs_random.conclusion: SBG is statistically above chance (p=0.01) but effect size is small (Cliff's δ=0.102).

test_2_sbg_vs_exception_fraction.description: SBG V5 AUROC vs exception_fraction baseline
test_2_sbg_vs_exception_fraction.ci_on_delta: Overlapping CIs; delta is within noise floor
test_2_sbg_vs_exception_fraction.conclusion: H0 NOT REJECTED. SBG does not beat exception_fraction. Delta=-0.042 (SBG worse).

test_3_dynamic_vs_static.conclusion: H7 SUPPORTED (survives Holm-Bonferroni). Dynamic execution features dramatically outperform static-only.

test_4_regression_detection_binomial.description: SBG regression detection vs chance (binomial test)
test_4_regression_detection_binomial.formula: P(X >= 5 | n=38, p=0.5) — but 5/38=13.2% is BELOW 50% chance
test_4_regression_detection_binomial.conclusion: Detection rate 5/38=13.2% is FAR BELOW chance (50%). SBG does NOT detect regressions above chance. Binomial test p≈1.0 for H0: rate ≤ 0.5.

test_5_holm_bonferroni_h1_h12.description: Holm-Bonferroni correction across H1-H12 hypothesis family
test_5_holm_bonferroni_h1_h12.conclusion: Of 12 hypotheses, 3 survive Holm-Bonferroni correction: H1, H7, H9. H7 (Dynamic > Static) and H9 (Inversion resolved by execution) are the only robustly supported claims.

overall_statistical_verdict.generalization_concern: DEV AUROC=0.488 below chance undermines generalization claims
